update sys_menu set
title = #{title},
component = #{component},
sort_value = #{sortValue},
status = #{status},
update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_deleted = 0
update sys_menu set is_deleted = 1 , update_time= now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select id,parent_id,title,component,sort_value,status,create_time,update_time from sys_menu where is_deleted = 0 order by sort_value
select count(id) from sys_menu where parent_id = #{parentId} and is_deleted = 0

select m.id,m.parent_id,m.title,m.component,m.sort_value,m.status,m.create_time,m.update_time from sys_menu m inner join sys_role_menu rm on m.id = rm.menu_id inner join sys_user_role ur on rm.role_id = ur.role_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and m.is_deleted = 0 order by m.sort_value
